content.title: Four takeaways from 'Noah Kahan: Out of Body' Netflix documentary
content.text: Four takeaways from 'Noah Kahan: Out of Body' Netflix documentary Skip to main contentFour takeaways from Noah Kahan’s new Netflix documentaryBy Matt Juul Globe Staff,Updated April 13, 2026, 2:30 p.m. Print this Article View Comments23Noah Kahan in "Noah Kahan: Out of Body."Courtesy of NetflixBetween his new album, “The Great Divide,” dropping later this month, performing on “Saturday Night Live” opposite Matt Damon in May, and embarking on another whirlwind tour this summer with four sold-out shows at Fenway Park, it’s shaping up to be a busy 2026 for Noah Kahan.
